section: Previous Year Questions (PYQ) Intelligence & Exam Analysis

metadata.source: Comprehensive Analysis of SBI Clerk Mains, IBPS Clerk Mains, and RRB OA Mains (2020-2025)

overall_pattern_and_shift_evolution.historical_trend: In 2018-2020, questions were predominantly static GK (headquarters, taglines, currency/capital). Post-2021, the General / Financial Awareness section in Clerk Mains has shifted dramatically toward: (1) In-depth RBI regulatory circulars, (2) Detailed provisions and eligibility of Government schemes, (3) Payment ecosystem nuances (UPI/NPCI/CBDC), and (4) Stressed assets and monetary policy mechanics.
overall_pattern_and_shift_evolution.ideal_target_score: 32 - 40 marks out of 50 in SBI/IBPS Clerk Mains; 28 - 35 marks out of 40 in RRB OA Mains.

topic_weightage_distribution.trend: Increasingly nuanced (asks numerical limits, percentages, and sub-clauses)

five_tier_priority_matrix.description: Topics that appear without exception in every single shift of SBI Clerk, IBPS Clerk, and RRB OA Mains.
topics: RBI Policy Rates (Repo 6.50%, SDF 6.25%, MSF 6.75%, Bank Rate 6.75%, CRR 4.50%, SLR 18%)
MPC Constitution (6 members, 4 quorum, 4% +/- 2% CPI target, Sec 45ZB)
Major Schemes: PMJDY (₹10k OD, ₹2L accident), PMJJBY (₹436/yr, 18-50 age), PMSBY (₹20/yr, 18-70 age), APY (18-40 age, ₹1k-5k)
MUDRA 4 Categories: Shishu (<=₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-5L), Tarun (₹5L-10L), Tarun Plus (₹10L-20L)
UPI & NPCI: UPI Lite (₹500/tx, ₹2,000 wallet), UPI 123Pay, RTGS (min ₹2 Lakh), NEFT (24x7 batch)
Deposit Insurance: DICGC (₹5 Lakh per depositor per bank, 90-day claim window)
five_tier_priority_matrix.preparation_strategy: Master all numerical figures, statutory sections, and revised updates to achieve 100% accuracy in under 15 seconds per question.

five_tier_priority_matrix.description: Requires conceptual clarity; examiners set traps on terminology and sub-categories.
topics: NPA Lifecycle & Stressed Assets: SMA-0 (1-30d), SMA-1 (31-60d), SMA-2 (61-90d), Substandard (<=12m), Doubtful, Loss
Agricultural NPA rules (2 crop seasons short duration, 1 crop season long duration)
Priority Sector Lending (PSL): 40% SCBs, 75% RRBs/SFBs, Agri sub-targets (18% overall, 10% small/marginal)
Basel III Capital Stack: CET1 (5.5%), Tier 1 (7.0%), Total Capital (9.0% SCBs / 12% PSBs), CCB (2.5%)
Money Market: T-Bills (91, 182, 364 days, min ₹10k), Commercial Paper (min ₹5L, 7d-1yr), CD (min ₹1L)
SARFAESI Act (60-day notice, DRT appeal 45 days, excludes agricultural land)
five_tier_priority_matrix.preparation_strategy: Solve interactive visualizer simulations and clear confusion pairs in the Confusion Buster.

five_tier_priority_matrix.description: Static institutional details, committee chairpersons, and banking acronyms.
topics: Committees: Hilton Young (RBI), Gorwala (SBI), Narasimham I & II, Sivaraman (NABARD), Nachiket Mor (Payments/SFBs), Urjit Patel (MPC)
Headquarters: SIDBI (Lucknow), IRDAI (Hyderabad), PFRDA (New Delhi), EXIM/NABARD/SEBI/RBI (Mumbai)
Key codes: IFSC (11 digits, 5th is '0'), MICR (9 digits: city, bank, branch), LEI (20 digits, ₹50 Cr+ threshold)
Account types: Nostro ('Ours with you'), Vostro ('Yours with us'), Loro ('Theirs'), Escrow
five_tier_priority_matrix.preparation_strategy: Use Spaced Repetition Flashcards and Banking Dictionary daily.

five_tier_priority_matrix.description: Fast-moving banking events from the last 4-6 months before the exam date.
topics: RBI Master Directions & Regulatory Penalties
International fast-payment linkages (UPI-PayNow, UAE Jaywan, etc.)
CBDC (e₹-R / e₹-W) pilot expansions and offline tests
Key leadership appointments (FSIB, RBI Deputy Governors, PSB MDs)

five_tier_priority_matrix.description: Obscure circular sub-clauses, minor cooperative bank license cancellations, and ambiguous gossip.
topics: Minor co-operative bank penal fines under ₹10 Lakh
Overly complex derivative formula derivations

five_tier_priority_matrix.preparation_strategy: Use the Question Selection Trainer to identify and immediately skip these trap questions.

common_exam_traps.examiner_trick: Option A mentions '90 days' for crop loan NPA.
common_exam_traps.correct_principle: Agricultural loans are NOT classified on a 90-day basis! They turn NPA after 2 crop seasons for short duration crops, and 1 crop season for long duration crops.

common_exam_traps.examiner_trick: Claiming ₹5 Lakh is insured for savings account and another ₹5 Lakh for fixed deposit in the same bank.
common_exam_traps.correct_principle: The ₹5 Lakh limit applies to the AGGREGATE of all accounts held in the SAME capacity and same right across all branches of that bank.

common_exam_traps.examiner_trick: Asking whether a bank can seize agricultural farmland mortgaged for a farm tractor loan without court intervention under SARFAESI.
common_exam_traps.correct_principle: NO. Section 31(i) of SARFAESI Act specifically EXEMPTS agricultural land from enforcement.

common_exam_traps.examiner_trick: Asking whether the 5th character of IFSC is letter 'O' or digit '0'.
Stating that ₹1 currency note bears the signature of the RBI Governor.
common_exam_traps.correct_principle: ₹1 note is issued by Ministry of Finance and bears the signature of the Finance Secretary.
